dcat_keyword_sm: Approved ROP 2022 - Map 12B - Significant Surface Water Contribution Areas and Ecologically Significant Groundwater Recharge Areas
dct_description_sm:
To provide the data required to recreate York Region Official Plan – 2022 Map 12B - "Significant Surface Water Contribution Areas and Ecologically Significant Groundwater Recharge Areas"

The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
